# The SecurityDevices PLIST example contains an unclosed Add key

The added PLIST example spells its Add entry as <key>Add<key>; the second tag lacks the closing slash. Fixed accepted documentation retains the same literal text. This source-level documentation error is separate from the JSON Add/Delete example, policy schema and historical Linux or Windows success reports. No PLIST parser or deployment was run.

Scope: Enterprise policy deployment documentation.
